name: manual_32e424
claim: Stage explicit paths, not git add -A, in a worktree where tests ran, and read git status --porcelain before every commit: tools write caches into the working tree when HOME or USERPROFILE is redirected. If a stray file is pushed, remove it with a follow-up commit (the repo's deletion hook needs GIT_ALLOW_FILE_DELETIONS with a written justification), never by rewriting history, and inspect the blob before judging what it exposes.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-04: running tests with USERPROFILE and HOME redirected made Windows PowerShell write Microsoft/Windows/PowerShell/ModuleAnalysisCache into the worktree, and git add -A committed and pushed it. Removing it needed a follow-up commit with the repo's audited file-deletion override (no force-push); the blob only listed a public module's command names.
